dataset_metadata.name: Onboard Diagnostic Hardware Specifications & Operational Constraints
dataset_metadata.source: NASA Space Medicine RAG Corpus (ISS & Exploration Medical Kit Hardware)
dataset_metadata.description: Pre-processed hardware capabilities, measurable analytes/metrics, and spaceflight limitations for offline RAG retrieval.

devices.name: Abbott i-STAT Portable Clinical Analyzer
clinical_triggers: Verify Creatinine before Ketorolac or Valacyclovir
Verify K+ before Lisinopril or TMP-SMX
Verify pCO2/pH/Lactate in hypercapnia, sepsis, or shock
devices.spaceflight_constraints: Cartridges have strict shelf-life expiration and are sensitive to ionizing radiation and thermal excursions. Requires bubble-free microgravity venous/fingerstick loading.
devices.search_text: Abbott i-STAT Chem8+ CG4+ blood chemistry electrolytes creatinine potassium lactate pCO2 pH expiration radiation sensitivity.

devices.name: Ultrasound-2 (Diagnostic Sonography)
protocols_supported: eFAST (Extended Focused Assessment with Sonography for Trauma)
Internal Jugular Vein (IJV) Compression & Color Doppler

diagnostic_thresholds.ijv_thrombosis_grading: Grade 3/4 non-compressible occlusive or stagnant flow

clinical_triggers: ONSD > 5.9 mm indicates elevated ICP / SANS progression
IJV Grade 3/4 thrombosis triggers Enoxaparin -> Apixaban protocol
eFAST positive free fluid triggers Level V trauma resuscitation
devices.spaceflight_constraints: Operator-dependent; autonomous crew rely on guided probe placement overlays and pre-loaded reference loops.
devices.search_text: Ultrasound-2 eFAST ONSD optic nerve sheath diameter > 5.9 mm SANS IJV internal jugular vein Doppler Grade 3 4 renal bladder appendix.

devices.name: C2M2 (Compact Hematology / CBC Analyzer)
clinical_triggers: Leukocytosis / left shift confirms acute infection (appendicitis, sepsis, pneumonia)
Rapid ALC drop (Andrews curves) quantifies Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) severity
Thrombocytopenia locks out Aspirin, NSAIDs, Enoxaparin, Apixaban, Clopidogrel
devices.spaceflight_constraints: Microgravity fluidics require closed-cartridge capillary handling without free-air bubbles.
devices.search_text: C2M2 CBC hematology WBC leukocytosis ALC absolute lymphocyte count ARS radiation thrombocytopenia platelets.

devices.name: PanOptic Fundoscope & Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT)
measurable_parameters: Corneal fluorescein staining (with Cobalt blue filter)
clinical_triggers: Frisen >= 1 or choroidal folds / RNFL thickening confirms SANS progression
Corneal fluorescein uptake confirms corneal abrasion (locks out Olopatadine)
devices.spaceflight_constraints: Requires pupil dilation or dark-adapted cabin; OCT provides objective quantitative SANS tracking over months.
devices.search_text: PanOptic Fundoscope OCT Optical Coherence Tomography Frisen Scale 0-5 choroidal folds RNFL SANS papilledema corneal abrasion.

devices.name: Tempus Pro & Holter Monitor
clinical_triggers: QTc > 470 ms locks out Azithromycin / high-dose Ondansetron
ST-elevation / ischemic ECG triggers ACS / EMTP Aspirin + Nitroglycerin + Clopidogrel
Rising ETCO2 confirms hypoventilation / opioid toxicity or cabin hypercapnia
devices.spaceflight_constraints: Primary Level V real-time telemetry and ACLS interception hub; conductive gel pads must be stored sealed to prevent drying.
devices.search_text: Tempus Pro Holter 12-lead ECG QTc ETCO2 defibrillator ACLS Level V interception telemetry.
